sn35.162:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko yena Bhagavā || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.162:1.2: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || ||
sn35.162:2.1: Yaṃ kho Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || ||
sn35.162:2.3: Cakkhuṃ kho Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo ||
sn35.162:2.4: Rupā aniccā tatra te chando pahātabbo ||
sn35.162:2.5: Cakkhuviññāṇam aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo ||
sn35.162:2.6: Cakkhusamphasso anicco tatra te chando pahātabbo ||
sn35.162:2.7: Yam pidam cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || || 5-6 Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || 7
sn35.162:2.8: Jivhā aniccā tatra te chando pahātabbo ||
sn35.162:2.12: Yam pidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || || 8-9 Kāyo || ||
sn35.162:2.13: Mano anicco tatra te chando pahātabbo ||
sn35.162:2.17: Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || 10
sn35.162:2.18: Yam kho Koṭṭhika aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti || || 2-3
